name: GenerateKeyPair
description: Generates a cryptographic key pair (public/private) for the specified algorithm.

params.name: algorithm
params.description: Algorithm string. For RSA, append key size: RSA (default 2048), RSA-4096. For EC, use curve name: EC (default P-256), P-384, P-521. For EdDSA: Ed25519, Ed448. For post-quantum: Kyber768, Dilithium3.

params.name: options
params.description: Optional struct with: format (PEM|DER|Base64, default PEM)
